scope: Read-only exact-model installed function key allowlist and four fixed raw additional settings reports, including NetMask/GATEIPAddress. No key/network option writes, biometric policy, secure vendor PUSH or Part 3 completion.

localChecks.workerLocalBuild: not run: local restore assets unavailable; solution build covered by successful Windows/Linux CI on implementedCode

integration.actualBrowser: Reads worker-created model-bound function key results and raw network reports from actual authenticated SQL history; no fetch mocks.
integration.freshPreflight: Not repeated automatically; full suite already runs worker and polling SQL checks. Explicit full-with-preflight remains available.

storage.payload: Optional typed fields inside existing immutable DeviceOperations.ResultJson; old snapshots remain valid.

authority.human: devices.settings.read with current selected-device scope; known operator/admin roles in existing catalogue
authority.service: devices.operations.execute plus independent devices.settings.read.execute and installed settings opt-ins
authority.keys: FunctionKeyReadApproval null by default; exact live product/firmware, unique explicit installed indices, evidence reference; never inferred from device name. Eight is an application work budget, not model key count.
authority.result: Exact approval reference/ordered index/model binding in child boundary; native false/exception has Reported=false with null values, never initialized zero; all five raw outputs retained only on valid read.
authority.network: Four fixed raw reports; no option name supplied by web/IPC and no reported mask/gateway used as connection pin or routing authority.
authority.bounds: Settings-only stdout 32768 characters; other stdout/stderr remain 4096. Per-key raw text 128 characters; approved work at most eight keys; oversized/invalid values never truncated to fabricate evidence.

supersededRuns.note: Superseded by combined change; concurrency cancellation is not success evidence.
